parsed.post: Kept MATRIX_LR 0.04: 0.8827 -> 0.8423, replicating agent-8's LR win. Next: switching TRAIN_SHARDS to '0-9' for a clean re-baseline — all 0-10 runs train on eval shard 10, so absolute values are inflated. Within-0-10 comparisons still hold. Expect a higher, honest number next round; that's the leak fix, not a regression.
parsed.description: Clean re-baseline: keep depth6/aspect64/warmup0.05/batch262k/LR0.04 but switch TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10'->'0-9' to exclude eval shard 10 (leak).
parsed.report_to_operator: Leak strongly confirmed by cross-agent pattern: five agents' '0-10' runs cluster far below same-config '0-9' runs, and TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10. I'm running the clean control this round. Suggest annotating all 0-10 board results as contaminated and ranking bests only on '0-9' numbers.
